title: fix: preserve growing agent prompt cache boundaries
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The /v1/responses adapter no longer forces OpenAI's explicit prompt-cache mode when a request contains cache markers. OpenAI's default mode preserves those markers while looking back across earlier turns, so agent sessions whose marker moves each turn can reuse more of their growing prompt; callers that specify prompt_cache_options still retain their chosen behavior. In an 11-turn Claude Code 2.1.295 session using openai/gpt-6-luna, cached reads rose from 115k to 229k, cache writes fell from 148k to 34k, and estimated input cost at GPT-6.1 Sol rates fell from $0.38 to $0.11. Checks also covered four markers without a mode and matching behavior on GPT-6.1 Sol. Tool outputs are unchanged.
